payload.title: architect has no text that reads where a unit stands
payload.body: The ledger now says where every unit stands, and bare plan show prints each unit's latest event, but no text in the architect's session (skills design and note; its role sign) spells a plan read at all. The cold read of the five session texts (opus-5-5, haiku-4-5) answers where a unit stands from show(unit), which the plan skill marks not the architect's because it prints the spec; the architect is left with the reports it is routed. If the architect is to learn a unit's standing from the ledger rather than from a message, it needs a spelled bare plan show read, and the plan skill (near its hook cap) or the architect's role sign is where it would go. Outside ledger-writers' outputs (architect.ts is static for it).
